Turner explicitly marks Kalasha Rumbur śīgou and Urtsun śigər as borrowed from Khowar śuɣur (earlier *śiguδ). The existing Khowar sand entry is the immediate donor; Trail and Cooper confirm śigaw with Urtsun śigur. No direct inherited link to Sanskrit sikatā is substituted.
